notes: Production slug remains wells-fargo-center. Shared 76ers and Flyers menu. Location corrections come from the live Xfinity concessions map. items.name: South Street Smoked Chicken Cheesesteak
items.description: A spectacular, smoky twist on the city's signature dish. Features smoked and deep-fried chicken thighs smothered in a rich "gouda wiz," sweet onion jam, and a heavy crunch of crispy chicken skin on a seeded roll.
items.notes: Location correction of the existing row. labeledNewFor2026 is set only to keep the row's existing isNewThisSeason value. This source did not call the dish new. Live map places The Coop at Section 107.

items.name: Rita's Water Ice
items.description: Rita's Water Ice at Sections 106 and 204. The previous row combined Rita's with Shake Shack. Shake Shack is a separate stand at Section 115.
items.notes: Location correction of the existing row. labeledNewFor2026 is set only to keep the row's existing isNewThisSeason value. This source did not call the dish new. Split from the combined Rita's and Shake Shack row. Shake Shack is now its own stand at Section 115.

items.name: Chickie’s & Pete’s
items.description: The undisputed, time-honored staple of Philly sports. Lines stay long for their world-famous, crinkle-cut Crabfries, heavily dusted in secret crab seasoning and served with a side of warm white cheese sauce for dipping.
items.notes: Location correction of the existing row. labeledNewFor2026 is set only to keep the row's existing isNewThisSeason value. This source did not call the dish new.

items.name: Port Richmond Style Pierogies
items.description: A massive nod to Philly’s Polish heritage. Pillowy, scratch-made pierogies tossed in rich brown butter sour cream and deeply caramelized onions.
items.notes: Location correction of the existing row. labeledNewFor2026 is set only to keep the row's existing isNewThisSeason value. This source did not call the dish new. Live map places Line Change at Section 107.

items.name: Truffled Short Rib Grilled Cheese
items.description: The ultimate cold-weather comfort food for a winter hockey night. Tender, 14-hour braised short rib layered with aged cheddar and a luxurious truffle peel on buttery brioche.
items.notes: Location correction of the existing row. labeledNewFor2026 is set only to keep the row's existing isNewThisSeason value. This source did not call the dish new. Live map places Line Change at Section 107.

items.name: Insomnia Cookies
items.description: The late-night cookie empire that was famously founded in a UPenn dorm room keeps the arena fueled with warm, gooey chocolate chip cookie packs.
items.notes: Location correction of the existing row. labeledNewFor2026 is set only to keep the row's existing isNewThisSeason value. This source did not call the dish new. Live map lists 118 and 207A. Section 122 was on the old row and is not on the current map.
